Mean age was 43.9 years (SD 13.3) and 50 of 53 respondents (94.3%) were obstetrician-gynecologists.
Familiarity with the labeling rule was reported by 29 of 35 (82.9%, 95% CI 67.3 to 91.9).

Amoxicillin was the most frequently reported drug (33 of 34, 97.1%, 95% CI 85.1 to 99.5) and lithium the least (1 of 33, 3.0%, 95% CI 0.5 to 15.3).

Unawareness responses reached 19 of 34 (55.9%, 95% CI 39.5 to 71.1) for the risk of erythromycin to the infant and 16 of 31 (51.6%, 95% CI 34.8 to 68.0) for the teratogenicity of domperidone.
